tasks.title: Calibrating vbat_scale
tasks.statement: Betaflight shows **{vfc} V** with `vbat_scale` = **{old}**, and a multimeter on the XT60 — **{vm} V**. Find the new `vbat_scale` value (without rounding).
tasks.solution: In voltage.c the voltage is directly proportional to vbat_scale, so new = old × V_multimeter / V_FC. An integer is entered in the CLI; a step of 1 corresponds to ≈ 0.9 % of the voltage.

tasks.title: Calibrating ibata_scale from mAh
tasks.statement: Over a flight Betaflight counted **{mfc} mAh** with `ibata_scale` = **{old}**, and the charger put back **{mch} mAh**. Find the new `ibata_scale` (without rounding).
tasks.solution: In current.c the current I[mA] = 10000·mV/ibata_scale + ibata_offset, that is, inversely proportional to scale. So new = old × mAh_FC / mAh_charger: if the FC undercounted, scale is reduced.

tasks.title: The current sensor offset
tasks.statement: The motors are stopped, an ammeter in series with the battery shows **{im} A**, Betaflight — **{ifc} A**, and the current `ibata_offset` = **{off} mA**. Find the new `ibata_offset` in mA.
tasks.solution: ibata_offset in mA is simply added to the current: new = old + (I_ammeter − I_FC) × 1000. It can be negative if the FC overstates the quiescent current.

tasks.title: The expected hover throttle
tasks.statement: A quadcopter with a mass of **{m} g**; each of the four motors gives a maximum of **{t} g** of thrust. Estimate the hover throttle in percent with the model “thrust ∝ throttle²”.
tasks.solution: T/W = 4·t/m; with thrust ∝ (throttle)² the hover throttle ≈ √(m / (4·t)). This is a rough estimate: the real throttle from the log of the first hover goes into ap_hover_throttle (before 2025.12 — gps_rescue_throttle_hover) and into the abort criterion (above 60 % — land).
